For a defensible A/B comparison use matched independent tasks, same revision, model, tools, permissions and acceptance criteria, separate contexts and alternating order. Include all retries and failures; preserve test and review quality. Do not start additional paid benchmark runs without explicit authorization. A normal task can be measured without claiming causal savings.
